### Premise re-derived on the tree this fire, ⛔ not read off the card

`origin/main:scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs:112` reads, verbatim:

```js
`${DEBT[name].issue ? ` (and close #${DEBT[name].issue} if it is done)` : ""}.`
```

⇒ the closing keyword immediately before an interpolated issue number is **live on main right now**. The card's premise holds. ⚠️ Line numbers are stale by default in this repo — re-derive before editing; this reading was taken at 07:1xZ.

### `Clause-②: no` — why

A diagnostic message re-spelling. It adds no key, no export, no registration, and widens no accept set; it narrows the ways a quoted gate message can accidentally close an issue. If the re-spelling turns out to touch a new key or export, `check-widening-tells` refuses the `no` with a `file:line` and the review will catch it — say so rather than working around it.
